notes.title: Patch 1.1
notes.content:
Few Fixes in the game
-Leaderboard now updates instantly so you don't have to open it twice
-floating tree fixed
-Santa now matches color after leaving a run
New Additions
-Personal Best Tracker added
-More info at the start of the game added
